planets.name: Kepler-220 d
planets.description: Transiting planet of Kepler-220 with a 28.1-day year, found in 2014.

text.card: Kepler-220 d was found in 2014 by Kepler as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is one of 4 planets known around Kepler-220. Its orbit and size follow Rowe et al. 2014's fit, the archive's default.
